commit_message: Move exact managed representation into campaign identity
pr_title: GameEngine: derive managed GGUF representation from file contents
pr_body:
## Summary

- parse GGUF metadata and every tensor descriptor during managed registration without reading tensor payload bytes
- persist a path-independent exact representation descriptor while retaining canonical file-type quantization only when GGUF metadata supports it
- make managed Benchmark Campaign eligibility and evidence identity use the GGUF-derived representation instead of filename markers
- keep legacy registry JSON readable and add synthetic GGUF coverage for filename independence, mixed types, malformed/unsupported files, and candidate eligibility
- move the owned exact representation directly into campaign identity without a redundant clone

## Scope

Managed Local AI GGUF registration and ADR 0156 Benchmark Campaign representation identity only.
